apps.name: Scribble: Notes, Diary & Tasks
apps.shortDescription: Secure, organized note-taking with scribble support.
apps.fullDescription: Scribble Notes is a feature-rich note-taking application designed for privacy and organization. With features like nested folders, app lock, rich text editing, and a unique frame-based scribble pad, it keeps your ideas secure and structured.

sections.title: Capture your moments
sections.content: A dedicated space for your daily journals. Experience a clean list view, an immersive book-like page reader, and a timeline view to naturally scroll through your life's events.

sections.title: Maintain your streaks
sections.content: Log your daily activities with a visual calendar view to track consistency, monitor progress, and build unbreakable long-term habits securely.

sections.title: Fast, clean list view
sections.content: A streamlined dashboard for all your thoughts. The Home screen brings all your notes and checklists together in a clean list or grid view. Easily verify, pin, archive, or categorize your notes right from the main screen, keeping your most important ideas always within reach. Quickly capture ideas using the new Speed Dial for rapid creation of notes, habits, or diary entries directly from the home screen.

sections.title: Find notes in seconds
sections.content: Instantly locate any note, checklist, or folder. The brilliant new Search UI filters results as you type, highlighting matching keywords in titles and descriptions. Smart breadcrumbs show exactly where each note lives, so you never lose track of your ideas.

sections.title: Organize your life without limits
sections.content: Organize your life without limits. Create main categories and deep sub-categories to keep your workspace perfectly structured. Whether it's "Personal > Finance > April" or "Work > Projects > Ideas," you can nest folders as deep as you need. Combine nested folders with an all-new seamless Tag Management system to categorize your content effortlessly.

sections.title: Match your device colors
sections.content: A personal experience that adapts to you. Choose from various themes, including dynamic Material You support that syncs with your device's wallpaper palette. Switch between distinct "OLED Dark" and "Light" modes for visual comfort in any environment. Experience the completely redesigned Settings UI and tailor your reading experience with custom font styles.

sections.title: Structure and Flexibility
sections.content: An editor designed for structure and flexibility. Build your notes using distinct blocks for paragraphs, headers, checklists, and code snippets, and rich Markdown tables. Drag and drop to reorder sections instantly, and enrich your notes with photos, audio recordings, and formatting effortlessly.

sections.title: Quick & secure access
sections.content: Keep your private thoughts truly private. Set up a secure passcode to lock the app or protect specific sensitive notes. Your data stays local and secure, ensuring only you have access to your personal information.

sections.title: Frame-by-frame animation sketching
sections.content: A digital canvas for your creativity. More than just a drawing tool, it supports frame-by-frame animation sketching and "playback" to review your thought process. Create multi-page sketches, correct mistakes with non-destructive erasing, and bring your visual ideas to life.

sections.title: Make the app yours
sections.content: We believe in total transparency. We request access only when necessary: **Camera** & **Audio** for media notes, **Storage** for backups, **Network** for cloud syncing, and **Exact Alarms** & **Notifications** for reliable reminders. You stay in control of your data.

sections.title: Core Technology
sections.content: Scribble Notes is built using **Flutter**, Google's UI toolkit for building natively compiled applications. It ensures high performance and smooth (60fps) animations on Android.

sections.title: Design Patterns
sections.content: The app follows **Clean Architecture** principles, with a clear separation of concerns. State management is handled by **Bloc** (Business Logic Component), ensuring predictable state changes and easy testing.

apps.name: SMS Stack
apps.fullDescription:
SMS Stack is a modern Flutter application designed to declutter your inbox and provide intelligent financial insights—without your data ever leaving your device. It automatically categorizes messages into "Personal", "Finance", and "Promos", extracts transaction details to build a financial dashboard, and helps you stay on top of bill payments.

Built with a "Privacy First" philosophy, all processing happens locally using a custom Regex engine. There are no external API calls for message analysis, ensuring your financial data remains secure on your phone.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: The SMS Parser Engine is the core component that gives SMS Stack its intelligence. It runs entirely on your device, reading incoming messages and applying a sophisticated set of rules to understand their context—whether it's a bank transaction, a bill reminder, or just a chat from a friend.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
The engine uses a "Waterfall" approach to parsing:
1.  **Normalization**: First, sender IDs are cleaned (e.g., `+91-HDFCBK` becomes `HDFCBK`).
2.  **Global Matching**: It checks against universal patterns like OTPs (`\d{4-8}`) or Account Numbers.
3.  **Regional Rules**: It applies country-specific logic (currently optimized for `IN` - India) to interpret currency symbols (`₹`, `INR`), date formats, and transaction keywords (`credited`, `debited`).
4.  **Extraction**: If a match is found, it extracts:
    *   **Amount**: The transaction value.
    *   **Type**: Credit (Income), Debit (Expense), or Bill.
    *   **Entity**: The Bank or Merchant name (resolved via alias lists).

sections.title: User Benefits
sections.content:
*   **100% Privacy**: No data leaves your phone. Unlike other apps that upload SMS to a server, our regex engine runs locally.
*   **Offline Capable**: Works perfectly without an internet connection.
*   **Instant**: Parsing happens in milliseconds as soon as an SMS arrives.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: The Finance Dashboard turns your chaotic SMS inbox into a clear financial summary. By aggregating transaction alerts from banks and wallets, it provides a real-time view of your liquidity and spending without needing to log into multiple banking apps.

sections.title: Key Capabilities
sections.content:
*   **Smart Balance**: Shows the latest "Available Balance" extracted from your most recent bank SMS.
*   **Income vs Expense**: Monthly breakdown of how much came in vs how much went out.
*   **Spend Analysis**: Visual charts showing daily spending trends.
*   **Bill Tracking**: Identifies "Payment Due" messages and lists them separately so you never miss a deadline.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: The Smart Inbox is your primary interface for viewing messages. Unlike a standard SMS app, it doesn't just list everything chronologically—it organizes them.

sections.title: Features
sections.content:
*   **Tabbed View**:
    *   **Personal**: Conversations with people (non-commercial).
    *   **Transactions**: Bank alerts, OTPs, and bills.
    *   **Promos**: Marketing spam and offers.
*   **Sender Mapping**:
    *   Automatically converts cryptic IDs like `VM-HDFCBK` to "HDFC Bank".
    *   Allows you to set your own Custom Names for senders.
*   **Powerful Search**:
    *   Search by text content ("Amazon").
    *   Search by amount ("5000").
    *   Search by time/date.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Your inbox is full of "Due Date" reminders, but they get lost in the noise. SMS Stack automatically detects these messages and separates them into a dedicated view, effectively turning your SMS inbox into a Bill Calendar.

sections.title: What it Does
sections.content:
*   **Auto-Detection**: Scans messages for keywords like "Due on", "Pay by", and "Bill amount".
*   **Calendar Sorting**: Organizes bills by their due date, showing the most urgent ones effectively.
*   **Reminders**: Can optionally schedule a local notification 1-3 days before the due date (Beta).

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: SMS Stack includes a proactive Spam Defense system designed to keep your Personal and Transaction tabs clean without deleting important messages.

sections.title: Features
sections.content:
*   **Spam Suggestions**: The app analyzes frequency and content models to identify likely spammers (e.g., "AD-123456"). It smartly excludes senders who also send OTPs or Finance alerts (like Banks) to prevent false positives.
*   **Block List**: You can block specific senders. Their messages will be hidden from the main inbox and they won't trigger notifications.
*   **Dismissal**: If the app suggests a sender incorrectly, you can "Dismiss" the suggestion, and it won't bother you again.

sections.title: Navigation
sections.content:
1.  Go to **Settings** -> **Spam Manager**.
2.  **Suggestions Tab**: Review potential spam. Tap "Block" to banish them or "Dismiss" to keep them.
3.  **Blocked Tab**: See who you've blocked. You can unblock them anytime.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Sender IDs like `VM-SBIINB` or `BZ-AMZPAY` are cryptic and not user friendly. Sender Mapping allows you to convert these into readable names like "SBI Bank" or "Amazon Pay".

sections.title: How it Works
sections.content:
*   **Auto-Resolution**: The app comes with a built-in dictionary for hundreds of popular Indian banks and services (HDFC, ICICI, Fliplart, Zomato, etc.).
*   **User Overrides**: You can define your own names. If you get messages from a local gym or school with a weird ID, you can rename it permanently.
*   **Sync**: Your custom mappings are synced to your Cloud Backup, so you don't lose them when you switch phones.

sections.title: How to Use
sections.content:
1.  Go to **Settings** -> **Operations** -> **Sender Mapping**.
2.  Tap **"Add New"** (+).
3.  Select the Sender ID from the dropdown (grouped by prefix).
4.  Enter the Display Name.
5.  Save. All past and future messages will now show the new name.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Protect your financial history and organization rules by backing them up to your personal Google Drive.

sections.title: Security First
sections.content:
*   **End-to-End Encryption**: Your backup file is encrypted on your device using **AES-256-GCM** before it is uploaded.
*   **Key Security**: The encryption key is derived from a password you set. We (the developers) never see your password or your data.
*   **Private Storage**: The file is stored in a hidden "App Data" folder in your Google Drive. It is not visible to other apps or even to you directly, preventing accidental deletion.

sections.title: Features
sections.content:
*   **What is Backed Up?**
    *   Sms Stack categorization (Personal/Finance/Promo).
    *   Sender Mappings (Your custom names).
    *   App Settings & Preferences.
*   **Frequency**: Set it to run Daily or Weekly in the background.

sections.title: How to Setup
sections.content:
1.  Go to **Settings** -> **Data Control**.
2.  Tap **"Backup & Restore"**.
3.  Sign in with Google.
4.  Set an Encryption Password.
5.  Tap **"Sync Now"**.

sections.title: Managing Your Data
sections.content:
You retain full control over your cloud data. To delete it permanently:
1.  Go to [drive.google.com/drive/settings](https://drive.google.com/drive/settings).
2.  Click **Manage Apps** on the left.
3.  Find **SMS Stack**.
4.  Click **Options** -> **Delete hidden app data**.

sections.title: Introduction

sections.title: Theme Engine

sections.title: Operations
sections.content:
Go to **Settings** -> **Operations** to manage data:
*   **Storage Optimization**: Auto-delete old OTPs (Older than 24h, 3 days, etc.) to save space.
*   **Full Resync**: If you feel the parser missed something, you can trigger a "Factory Reset" of the local database to re-read all SMS from scratch (without losing personal data).

sections.title: Available Features
sections.content:
1.  **Biometric Lock**: Secure the app with your Fingerprint or Face ID. Requires authentication every time you open the app.
2.  **Smart Bill Reminders**: Receive a phone notification 2 days before a bill is due. (Requires 'Alarm' permission).
3.  **Visual Analytics (Alpha)**: A deeper dive into your spending with Pie Charts and Bar Graphs (sender-wise breakdown).

sections.title: SMS & Contacts
sections.content:
To function as an SMS Organizer, we request specific permissions:
*   **Read SMS (`READ_SMS`)**: Used to categorize messages and extract transaction details. **Local Only**.
*   **Receive SMS (`RECEIVE_SMS`)**: Required to detect and process new incoming messages in real-time.
*   **Send SMS (`SEND_SMS`)**: Required for sending replies directly from the app's notification or UI.
*   **Read Contacts (`READ_CONTACTS`)**: Used to display contact names and photos for better identification. **In-Memory Only**.
*   **Read Phone State (`READ_PHONE_STATE`)**: Used to detect Multi-SIM information (Slot 1 vs Slot 2) for organizing messages properly.

sections.title: System Integrations
sections.content:
*   **Notifications (`POST_NOTIFICATIONS`)**: Required to post alerts for new messages.
*   **Alarms (`SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM`)**: Required to schedule precise notifications for Bill Due Dates.
*   **Biometric (`USE_BIOMETRIC`)**: Used for the App Lock feature to secure your data.
*   **Vibration (`VIBRATE`)**: Used for tactile feedback on notifications.
*   **Boot Completed (`RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`)**: Required to restart our processing service (listeners) after you restart your phone.

sections.title: Network Usage
sections.content:
*   **Internet (`INTERNET`)**: The app uses internet access **strictly** for:
    1.  Fetching parser rule updates (Firebase Remote Config).
    2.  Performing encrypted backups (Google Drive API).
    3.  **No SMS data is ever sent to our servers.**

sections.title: High-Level Overview
sections.content:
SMS Stack follows **Clean Architecture** principles, separating the codebase into three main layers:

1.  **Presentation Layer (`lib/features/`)**:
    *   **UI**: Widgets/Screens.
    *   **State Management**: `Bloc` (Business Logic Components).
2.  **Domain/Service Layer (`lib/core/services/`)**:
    *   **Services**: `SmsService`, `NotificationService`, `PermissionService`.
    *   **Logic**: `SmsParserEngine` (Regex Logic).
3.  **Data Layer (`lib/core/database/`)**:
    *   **Database**: Drift (SQLite) with FTS5.
    *   **DTOs**: `SmsMessage` (from system) -> `Message` (db entity).

sections.title: Core Patterns
sections.content:
*   **BLoC Pattern**: Used for Predictable State Management. Uses `hydrated_bloc` to persist UI state.
*   **Dependency Injection**: Uses `get_it` and `injectable` for managing singletons.
*   **Repository Pattern**: `SmsService` abstracts the data source.

sections.title: Schema Structure
sections.content:
The parsing logic is defined in `assets/rules/sms_rules.json`. It follows a hierarchical "Waterfall" structure:
*   **Global Rules**: Universal patterns like OTPs or Account Numbers.
*   **Regional Rules (IN)**: Country-specific logic for currency (`₹`), date formats, and keywords.
*   **Extraction Strategy**: Priority order: Bill > Debit/Credit > Balance > OTP.

sections.title: Encryption Standards
sections.content:
*   **Algorithm**: AES-256-GCM.
*   **Key Derivation**: PBKDF2 with 10,000 iterations.
*   **Salt**: Random 16-byte salt per file.

sections.title: Process
sections.content:
1. Serialize SQLite tables to JSON.
2. GZIP Compress.
3. Encrypt with User Password.
4. Upload to Google Drive `appDataFolder` (Hidden).

sections.title: Algorithm
sections.content:
Identifies spammers based on:
1.  **Category**: Classified as `Promo/Spam`.
2.  **No Critical History**: No Finance/Bill/OTP messages.
3.  **Frequency**: High volume.
4.  **Exclusion**: Not in Contacts.

sections.title: Integration
sections.content:
Uses a `BroadcastReceiver` (Kotlin) to intercept SMS, parse them, and post notifications using `MessagingStyle`. 
*   **Flutter Bridge**: Syncs read state and notifications via `MethodChannel`.

apps.name: IKY — Family Tree & Genealogy
apps.shortDescription: A private family tree app with kinship engine and real-time genealogy.
apps.fullDescription: IKY (I Know You) is a full-stack family relationship management platform built for privacy and depth. It allows families to collaboratively build, manage and explore their genealogy through a rich interactive graph — complete with a Kongu Tamil kinship engine that computes culturally-aware relationship labels up to 6 generations. Explore the live demo with pre-populated, obfuscated sample families.

sections.title: Explore relationships visually
sections.content: A fully interactive canvas that renders your family as a real-time graph. Pan, zoom, and center on any member. Switch between Default Tree, Family Groups, and Genealogy views to explore the same data from different perspectives.

sections.title: Know exactly who everyone is
sections.content: A custom Kongu Tamil kinship resolution engine traverses the graph up to 6 generations and computes the precise cultural relationship label for any pair of people — Mama, Akka, Appuchi, and beyond. Works bidirectionally for any selected member.

sections.title: Trace lineage across generations
sections.content: The Genealogy canvas renders an ancestor-descendant hierarchy tree, displaying parent-child connections across multiple generations. Placeholders are used for known-but-unregistered ancestors, maintaining structural integrity of the tree.

sections.title: Groups within your family
sections.content: Family members are automatically organized into household groups by nuclear family unit. Each group is color-coded and can be independently collapsed or expanded on the canvas for clarity in large families.

sections.title: Review inferred relationships
sections.content: When the kinship engine infers new relationships from existing data, family admins receive pending alerts to review and approve or reject them. This ensures the family graph stays accurate and consensual.

sections.title: No data. No account. Just explore.
sections.content: The public demo is powered by a fully offline in-memory mock backend. All names and dates have been obfuscated with fictional Tamil personas. Your actions during the demo session are ephemeral — nothing is sent to any server.

sections.title: Technology
sections.content: Built with **Flutter** (mobile + web) and a **Dart Shelf** REST API backend. State management via **Riverpod**. Routing via **GoRouter**. Network layer via **Dio** with a custom interceptor architecture for demo mode.

sections.title: Kinship Computation
sections.content: The kinship engine is implemented in **TypeScript** as an XML-rule-driven attribute extractor. It traverses the family graph using BFS up to depth 6, resolving culturally specific relationship labels for the Kongu Tamil dialect.

apps.name: Alarm Clock
apps.shortDescription: Alarms, timers, reminders & routines — with widgets and voice shortcuts.
apps.fullDescription: Alarm Clock brings every time-based tool into one fast, local-first app: reliable alarms with a bright full-screen ring screen, timers, a stopwatch, reminders, and location-aware work routines. Home-screen widgets stay in sync with your device's wallpaper colors (Material You), and a voice shortcut bar lets you create alarms, timers and reminders just by talking. No account, no cloud sync, no ads — everything lives on your device.

sections.title: Bright, unmissable ring screen
sections.content: A dedicated full-screen alarm screen that shows over the lock screen, with large Snooze and Stop controls. Set repeat days, a custom label, and your own ringtone per alarm.

features.title: Timers & Stopwatch
features.subtitle: Quick to start, easy to track

sections.title: Built-in timers and stopwatch
sections.content: Quick-start timer presets, a running-timer list, and a lap-tracking stopwatch — all reachable from the same dashboard as your alarms.

features.title: Reminders
features.subtitle: Things you don't want to forget

sections.title: Reminders that stick
sections.content: One-off or recurring reminders with due dates, shown alongside your alarms and timers on the same dashboard.

features.title: Routines & Work Geofence
features.subtitle: Automation based on where you are

sections.title: Location-based routines
sections.content: Set up a routine that triggers automatically when you arrive at or leave a place you choose — for example, a "Work" routine. Pick the location on a map with an adjustable radius; a human-readable place name is resolved for you automatically.

sections.title: Talk to set alarms, timers and reminders
sections.content: A voice shortcut bar understands natural phrases like "set an alarm for 7am" or "remind me to call mom in 20 minutes." A dedicated practice page lets you try every supported phrase with live transcript and waveform feedback, so you always know it's listening.

sections.title: Widgets that match your wallpaper
sections.content: Three home-screen widgets — an action shortcut, quick timers, and a routine launcher — each configurable for light/dark/auto mode, opacity, and a color source that can follow your device's Material You wallpaper palette (Android 12+) or your in-app accent color.

sections.title: Personalize the app
sections.content: Switch between light and dark themes, or opt in to Material You dynamic color sourced from your device's wallpaper (off by default — your choice).

sections.title: One-time unlock, always visible
sections.content: Unlimited alarms, unlimited profiles, unlimited reminders, and the work-geofence routine feature. Premium status is always shown — as a reminder when unlocked, or as a feature checklist when it isn't — never hidden.

sections.title: Core Technology
sections.content: Alarm Clock is built using **Flutter**, with a native Kotlin layer for alarm scheduling, the full-screen ring activity, and home-screen widgets (AppWidgetProvider/RemoteViews).

sections.title: Design Patterns
sections.content: State management is handled by **Bloc/Cubit**, with a clear separation between UI, services, and the native platform channel layer. All data is persisted locally via **sqflite** — no backend server.

sections.title: Live wallpaper-following widgets
sections.content: On Android 12+, widget colors are resolved from `@android:color/system_accent1_*`/`system_neutral*` resources, so the launcher re-tints widgets automatically when the wallpaper changes — no app code runs for that update.

sections.content:
The Application requests the following Device permissions. Each is used only
for the stated purpose, and each can be reviewed or revoked at any time in
Your Device's App Settings:

| Permission | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Exact Alarms** (`SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM`, `USE_EXACT_ALARM`) | To ring alarms, timers, and reminders at the exact time You set. |
| **Notifications** (`POST_NOTIFICATIONS`) | To show alarm, timer, and reminder notifications. |
| **Full-Screen Intent** (`USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT`) | To show the full-screen ring/snooze/stop screen when an alarm fires, including over the lock screen. |
| **Wake Lock / Foreground Service (+ Media Playback)** | To keep the ringtone playing reliably while an alarm or timer is going off, even if the screen turns off. |
| **Ignore Battery Optimizations** | Requested optionally, so Android's battery-saving features don't delay or silently skip a scheduled alarm. |
| **Boot Completed** (`RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`) | To reschedule Your alarms after the Device restarts (Android clears all pending alarms on reboot). |
| **Vibrate** | For alarm/timer vibration. |
| **Microphone** (`RECORD_AUDIO`) | Only when You actively use the voice-command feature (the NLP mic button, or the voice-command practice/help page). Speech is recognized using Your Device's own on-device/system speech-recognition service; We do not record, store, or transmit Your voice audio to any server We operate. |
| **Location** (fine, coarse, background) | Only used for the optional, Premium "work routine" (geofence) feature, so a routine can trigger when You arrive at or leave a place You chose (e.g. "Work"). Location is read on-device to evaluate the geofence and is stored only in Your local routines database. It is **never** collected if You do not set up a location-based routine, and background location is only requested when a routine actually needs to run while the app isn't open. |
| **Internet** | Used only for the two purposes described in §4 and §5 below — never for tracking or advertising. |

features.subtitle: The one external lookup this app makes

sections.title: Third-Party Service: Location Name Lookup (OpenStreetMap Nominatim)
sections.content:
When You pick a location for a work routine, the app shows You a
human-readable place name (e.g. "Koramangala, Bengaluru") instead of raw
coordinates. To do this, it sends the latitude/longitude You selected to
**OpenStreetMap's Nominatim API** (`nominatim.openstreetmap.org`), a
third-party, independently-operated service not owned by Us.

- Only the coordinates are sent — no name, email, account identifier, or
  other Personal Data accompanies the request.
- This happens only when You are actively setting up or editing a
  location-based routine; it is not a background or periodic call.
- If the request fails (e.g. You are offline), the app simply shows the raw
  coordinates instead — this lookup is best-effort and never blocks the
  feature from working.
- This exchange is governed by
  [OpenStreetMap's own privacy policy](https://wiki.osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy),
  not this one. We do not control, and are not responsible for, how
  OpenStreetMap/Nominatim itself handles that request on its servers.
